profile.org_note: Family-owned company with two co-headquarters (Glen Allen, VA, phone 804-762-4800, and Cary, NC, phone 919-461-0587) and three businesses: HHHunt Homes (for-sale homes in VA and NC), HHHunt Communities (master-planned land development around Richmond) and HHHunt Apartment Living (Abberly apartments in six states). Land decisions sit with David Brunner (VP Land Acquisition, all product types, with land acquisition managers in Richmond, Raleigh and Wilmington), Jonathan Ridout (GM of Communities) and Hans Klinger (entitlements); finance sits with CFO Ann Kelly and SVP Finance and Treasury Steve Brant, who become CEO and CFO on 2027-07-01.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + middle initial + last name @hhhunt.com (e.g. dabrunner@hhhunt.com); the middle initial cannot be guessed, so no emails were built
profile.summary: Private, family-owned Mid-Atlantic and Southeast residential company founded in 1966; nearly 500 employees. For-sale homebuilding is only in Virginia (Richmond) and North Carolina (Raleigh, Southern Pines, Wilmington): the company site reports 580 homes closed in 2025 (430 VA, 150 NC), fewer than the Builder 100 figure. It is not a pure homebuilder: it also develops its own master-planned communities and owns and manages about 8,885 apartments in 27 communities across MD, VA, TN, NC, SC and GA; it sold its senior-living division in 2022. A plausible but small land-banking customer: it self-develops lots in Richmond and buys finished lots elsewhere, with no public record of outside land-bank capital.
